enunciado: Given the temperature array {21, 25, 19, 30, 27, 18}, use foreach to show them, count the hot days (>= 25) and compute the sum.
objetivos: Iterate over a collection without managing indexes
Know when to use for and when to use foreach
pistas: foreach (int t : temps) visits each element in order.
You do not need the position, only the value.
If you needed the index, you would use a classic for.
